history.label: history, not public before 2024-10-17
history.note: The estimates before the table, published apart (the ruling of 19 October 2026): not a point-in-time series, outside the declaration and read by nothing. They carry no availability.

role_note: An external check on H7m goalposts 1 and 3, reported and never deciding (Eleonora, 19 October 2026); R and S stay the deciding benchmarks, and nothing reads this series into a goalpost or a score.
vintage_note: The latest release's figures, which may differ from the first print: the Fed serves only its latest workbook, so earlier releases are not recoverable. Each estimate is read as public from the release repo_liquidity.rde.release_for assigns it (12:00 New York time on the third Thursday, or on the first business day after an FOMC blackout that holds it), never before the launch on 2024-10-17.
